lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਖਣੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh vekhan bolanaa naam japat sukh paaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh beholds and speaks the Naam, the Name of the Lord; chanting the Naam, he finds peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਤਿਮਰ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh giaan pragaasiaa timar agiaan a(n)dher chukaaiaa ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the spiritual wisdom of the Gurmukh shines forth; the black darkness of ignorance is dispelled. ||2||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੈਲੇ ਮਰਹਿ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh maile marahi gavaar ||
lines.translation: The filthy, foolish, self-willed manmukhs die.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh niramal har raakhiaa ur dhaar ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs are immaculate and pure; they keep the Lord enshrined within their hearts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhanat naanak sunahu jan bhaaee ||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, listen, O Siblings of Destiny!

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sevihu haumai mal jaaee ||
lines.translation: Serve the True Guru, and the filth of your ego shall be gone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸੰਸਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧਾ ਨਿਤ ਮਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dar sa(n)saa dookh viaape sir dha(n)dhaa nit maar ||
lines.translation: Deep within, the pain of skepticism afflicts them; their heads are constantly assaulted by worldly entanglements.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਸੂਤੇ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਗਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: doojai bhaai soote kabahu na jaagahi maaiaa moh piaar ||
lines.translation: Asleep in the love of duality, they never wake up; they are attached to the love of Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਵੀਚਾਰਹਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਾ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam na chetahi sabad na veechaarahi ihu manamukh kaa beechaar ||
lines.translation: They do not remember the Name, and they do not contemplate the Word of the Shabad; this is the view of the self-willed manmukhs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: har naam na bhaaiaa birathaa janam gavaaiaa naanak jam maar kare khuaar ||3||
lines.translation: They do not love the Lord's Name, and they lose their life uselessly. O Nanak, the Messenger of Death attacks them, and humiliates them. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਬਖਸੀਅਨੁ ਸੋ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no har bhagat sach bakhaseean so sachaa saahu ||
lines.translation: He alone is a true king, whom the Lord blesses with true devotion.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਮੁਹਤਾਜੀ ਲੋਕੁ ਕਢਦਾ ਹੋਰਤੁ ਹਟਿ ਨ ਵਥੁ ਨ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis kee muhataajee lok kadhadaa horat hat na vath na vesaahu ||
lines.translation: People pledge their allegiance to him; no other store stocks this merchandise, nor deals in this trade.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਸਨਮੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਸਿ ਲਏ ਵੇਮੁਖ ਭਸੁ ਪਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat janaa kau sanamukh hovai s har raas lae vemukh bhas paahu ||
lines.translation: That humble devotee who turns his face towards the Guru and becomes sunmukh, receives the Lord's wealth; the faithless baymukh, who turns his face away from the Guru, gathers only ashes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਹਹਿ ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤੀ ਤਿਨਾ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਜਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ke naam ke vaapaaree har bhagat hahi jam jaagaatee tinaa neR na jaahu ||
lines.translation: The Lord's devotees are dealers in the Name of the Lord. The Messenger of Death, the tax-collector, does not even approach them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਲਦਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har naam dhan ladiaa sadaa veparavaahu ||7||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak has loaded the wealth of the Name of the Lord, who is forever independent and care-free. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਟਿਆ ਹੋਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: is jug mahi bhagatee har dhan khatiaa hor sabh jagat bharam bhulaaiaa ||
lines.translation: In this age, the devotee earns the wealth of the Lord; all the rest of the world wanders deluded in doubt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee naam man vasiaa anadin naam dhiaaiaa ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to dwell in his mind; night and day, he meditates on the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸ ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bikhiaa maahi udaas hai haumai sabad jalaaiaa ||
lines.translation: In the midst of corruption, he remains detached; through the Word of the Shabad, he burns away his ego.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਰੇ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਣੇਦੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap tariaa kul udhare dha(n)n janedee maaiaa ||
lines.translation: He crosses over, and saves his relatives as well; blessed is the mother who gave birth to him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਹਜੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa sahaj sukh man vasiaa sache siu liv laaiaa ||
lines.translation: Peace and poise fill his mind forever, and he embraces love for the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹਾਦੇਉ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਭੁਲੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: brahamaa bisan mahaadeu trai gun bhule haumai mohu vadhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva wander in the three qualities, while their egotism and desire increase.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਮੋਨੀ ਭੁਲੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)dit paR paR monee bhule doojai bhaai chit laaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Pandits, the religious scholars and the silent sages read and debate in confusion; their consciousness is centered on the love of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਜੰਗਮ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਭੁਲੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jogee ja(n)gam sa(n)niaasee bhule vin gur tat na paaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Yogis, wandering pilgrims and Sanyaasees are deluded; without the Guru, they do not find the essence of reality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦੁਖੀਏ ਸਦਾ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੇ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh dukheee sadaa bhram bhule tinhee birathaa janam gavaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The miserable self-willed manmukhs are forever deluded by doubt; they waste away their lives uselessly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਸਮਧੇ ਜਿ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam rate seee jan samadhe j aape bakhas milaaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam are balanced and poised; forgiving them, the Lord blends them with Himself. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਸਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak so saalaaheeai jis vas sabh kichh hoi ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, praise Him, who has control over everything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀਹੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tisahi sarevahu praaneeho tis bin avar na koi ||
lines.translation: Remember Him, O mortals - without Him, there is no other at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh a(n)tar man vasai sadaa sadaa sukh hoi ||2||
lines.translation: He dwells deep within those who are Gurmukh; forever and ever, they are at peace. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਨ ਖਟਿਓ ਸੇ ਦੇਵਾਲੀਏ ਜੁਗ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinee guramukh har naam dhan na khatio se devaaleee jug maahi ||
lines.translation: Those who do not become Gurmukh and earn the wealth of the Lord's Name, are bankrupt in this age.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਮੰਗਦੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਸਭ ਜਗਤ ਮਹਿ ਕੋਈ ਮੁਹਿ ਥੁਕ ਨ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: oi ma(n)gade phirahi sabh jagat mahi koee muhi thuk na tin kau paahi ||
lines.translation: They wander around begging all over the world, but no one even spits in their faces.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਾਈ ਬਖੀਲੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਖੋਵਨਿ ਸਗਵਾ ਭੀ ਆਪੁ ਲਖਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: paraaee bakheelee karahi aapanee parateet khovan sagavaa bhee aap lakhaahi ||
lines.translation: They gossip about others, and lose their credit, and expose themselves as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਧਨ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਚੁਗਲੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਚੁਗਲੀ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਓਇ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਥੈ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis dhan kaaran chugalee karahi so dhan chugalee hath na aavai oi bhaavai tithai jaahi ||
lines.translation: That wealth, for which they slander others, does not come into their hands, no matter where they go.
